caption: The drawing features a cream-colored background with sixteen squares, each depicting a different fabric pattern in a 4x4 grid layout. The fabric swatches show a variety of designs and colors, primarily in shades of brown, beige, red, black, and white. The patterns include floral motifs, geometric patterns, stripes, small stylized shapes, and circular designs. Some squares have repeating small flowers or leaves, others have bolder, more central motifs like a single flower or nest. The lower part of the image contains text: "Patterns – exact size" is written below the grid, "Westchester County" in the lower left, and "Maud Schmid" in the lower right. Each square contains intricate detailing typical of historic fabric designs.
title: Friendship Quilt-Patchwork Section
